The '''Public Hall''' was a recreational center near [[Byrneport]] in [[Byrne City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]]. It was converted into housing for refugees looking to escape the planet in the face of the impending [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].
